limitations_and_boundaries: Suboptimal performance in predicting combined-perturbation effects; scouter's improvement over baselines was limited, and other deep learning/foundation models performed worse than baselines.
Limited generalizability of deep learning and foundation models, especially for combined perturbations.
Chemical perturbation prediction, especially for chemical combinations, remains underdeveloped; baseReg baseline achieved highest accuracy, indicating a gap in specialized algorithms.
The study's conclusions are based on the specific datasets and preprocessing choices; performance may vary with different data characteristics.
Scalability and robustness assessments were limited; scFoundation had long runtime and was not evaluated for robustness.
The benchmark focused on transcriptomic responses; other modalities or downstream functional effects were not assessed.
